summary: Mr. Bell, the school principal, the Milestone 69 people mini-boss: a 2x2 body sheet (chaos idle, mid-shout into his megaphone; the burst, hall passes flying; soothed, rubbing his temple; calm, waving), drawn to Mrs. Flurry's sheet with the school staff concept for adult proportions.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini from Mrs. Flurry's raw body sheet for the watercolour style, size, and swirly eyes, and the school staff concept sheet for adult proportions.

edits.prompt: A 2x2 character sheet of a NEW character, drawn in exactly the style of the first reference image (the woman in the four cells): the same chibi proportions with a big head, the same soft watercolour with thin warm-brown ink outlines, and the same size of figure in each of the four cells. The character is Mr. Bell, the kindly principal of a small-town elementary school: a grown-up man with round glasses, tidy gray hair, rosy cheeks, a brown tweed jacket with elbow patches, a mustard-yellow bow tie, dark trousers, and shiny brown shoes, holding a big silver megaphone in one hand. Top-left cell: Mr. Bell fizzy, his eyes swirly purple spirals, mouth wide open mid-shout into the megaphone, tiny purple fizz bubbles popping around his head. Top-right cell: bursting, arms flung wide, the megaphone blasting swirling purple sound waves and a flurry of small paper hall passes. Bottom-left cell: soothed, his swirly eyes drooping tired, the megaphone lowered, one hand rubbing his temple. Bottom-right cell: calm and warm, smiling gently, the megaphone resting at his side, his other hand raised in a friendly wave. Use a restrained warm palette and absolutely no pink or magenta anywhere on the character or his props; the plain background must be bright flat magenta (#FF00FF) filling every cell. No text, no labels, no shadows on the background, no faded copies, no extra figures, and every figure whole and uncropped inside its own cell.
edits.note: Kept as generated: four whole figures on a clean flat magenta key. The name Mr. Bell is a placeholder until the owner picks one.

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-person.ts principal. The shared person builder keys magenta, drops detached islands under 120 px, despills the alpha edge, scales the chaos idle body to 380 px, and adds the shared hamster aura.

measuredCentres.bodyCentreMethod: mean opaque-pixel centroid across the four generated body frames
